title: LG watch not working with xdrip since wear OS update
symptom: After a Wear OS update, the xDrip watch face on an LG Watch Sport shows lagging readings, missed readings when not actually missed, and appears disconnected from the app, despite the phone having 100% capture rate.
fix: The user resolved the issue by factory resetting the LG Sport watch, updating it to the current Wear OS release (Oct 2018), installing the latest xDrip+ nightly (Oct 15th 2018) on the Pixel 2 XL, and reinstalling the xDrip+ watch face on the watch.
evidence_quote: I have resolved this issue by performing the following steps: 1) Factory reset the LG Sport watch. 2) Update the watch to the current Wear OS release( Oct 2018 ). 3) Install the latest xdrip+ nightly ( Oct 15th 2018) on my Pixel 2 XL. 4) Install the xdrip+ watch face on the my LG sport watch ( google play.. apps on my phone ) 5) Watch face works without issues.
